T-001.Title: Correct the tracked active-directory marker witness

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Red first in its own round trip: the retained tracked active-directory marker test fails at baseline with two change.superseded-replacement-not-found errors. Replace only that test's body (the describe title stays tracked active-directory marker) and give the corrected test an it title containing path-scoped HEAD archive, so the measured artifact carries a deterministic marker case name. The test asserts git ls-files --error-unmatch .ngrace/changes/active/.gitkeep exits 0 and names the path; runs a path-scoped git archive of HEAD restricted to the marker with the git status read from the git process; runs the tar listing with the tar status read from the tar process and requires exactly the marker as the single regular entry, rejecting a symlink or directory; extracts the marker and asserts its bytes equal git show of the HEAD blob; and lints the real repository with its active replacement links intact at 0 errors and 0 warnings. It never fabricates an applied bundle, deletes real archive history, or edits the shared fixture builder. Read exit codes directly, never through a pipe. Paste the red baseline failure and the green targeted run.

T-002.Title: Invalidate and produce the measured test-metrics.json, then verify it

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Red first in its own round trip: the narrow read-only verification below fails on the committed artifact because the renamed marker case is absent from its stale identities. Then delete the stale test-metrics.json so it can no longer satisfy the runner's file-set-and-count-sum freshness predicate, and run bun run test:metrics as the required artifact-production action. That command is the artifact writer: it leaves a fresh artifact untouched, so the stale artifact must be invalidated first; with the file absent it writes the provisional tree artifact and then, after its one suite invocation, the measured JUnit-derived artifact. Do not edit the metrics runner. After the action the narrow read-only verification must pass: test-metrics.json exists, its files tests counts sum to its tests length (internal file/case agreement), it carries the renamed marker case under scripts/audit-regressions.test.ts whose name contains path-scoped HEAD archive, and it has no (provisional) entry. Report the measured artifact's audit-regressions case count and the zero provisional count; never treat the runner's freshness predicate as evidence of correct case identities. The close's --assertions final --run-commands then runs bun run validate:ci, whose test:metrics segment leaves the now-fresh artifact byte-identical. That is the second and last suite invocation.

Verification.Command: bun -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const a=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("test-metrics.json","utf8")); let sum=0; for(const f of a.files) sum+=f.tests; if(sum!==a.tests.length) throw new Error("file/case sum mismatch"); if(a.tests.some(function(t){return t.name==="(provisional)";})) throw new Error("provisional entries"); if(!a.tests.some(function(t){return t.file==="scripts/audit-regressions.test.ts" && t.name.includes("path-scoped HEAD archive");})) throw new Error("renamed marker case absent"); console.log("measured artifact ok:", a.tests.length);'
